free_tier.stated: none reachable: no free self-serve hosting product exists. iHeartRadio is a podcast distribution/directory: podcasters submit an RSS feed hosted elsewhere, and the podcaster portal states it is currently unavailable. First-party help lists only partner hosting platforms (Omny Studio, Spreaker, Libsyn, Audioboom, PodBean, Pinecast, Podomatic).
